notes.title: Playtest Release 14
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ship autopilot system. You can now assign ships to fly between station docks and deliver items automatically. Access the ship autopilot in the status menu while piloting, or in the fleet menu with [Y].
[*] Added a new research category: Computation Science. Now, most of the mid-tier research requires both Material and Computation Science. Computation Science is produced at Science Labs with Basic Circuits.
[*] Added paint customization for ships, stations, and characters.
[*] Added the Plasma Lance weapon.
[*] Added Advanced Plating item.
[*] Added lift and walkway station modules.
[*] Added windshield dust effect when piloting and improved the ship’s flight trail effect.
[*] Changed docking behavior so that the ship always docks at the closest available dock.
[*] Revamped the Research Tree visuals, adding more information to each technology card and tooltip.
[*] Add fire group configuration to the ship weapons, accessible on the ship status window.
[*] Added a new mission system, and updated the tutorials.
[/list]

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Large Resource Asteroids have 4x more resources.
[*] Mining Drone Bay Research Cost 50 >> 30
[*] Enrichment Chamber Research Cost 100 >> 200
[*] Warp Drive Research Cost 500 >> 350
[*] Warp Fuel Research Cost 100 >> 200
[*] 2x2 Station Research Cost 200 >> 100
[*] Ship Container Research Cost 50 >> 100
[*] Mining Drone Bay no longer requires basic circuits to build, and can now be researched after completing Logistics I.
[*] Increased the started items. Now you have to craft 5 hull plates and 5 lightweight frames to build the first station, instead of 10 and 10.
[*] Increased the generation frequency of small asteroids.
[*] Slightly increased the generation frequency of Relic Crescents.
[*] Remove the shipyard top and bottom pieces pending a rework of the shipyard bounds requirements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed freezing and desync issues in 3+ player multiplayer.
[*] Fixed current research HUD not loading progress correctly.
[*] The research tree is now clamped to the viewport when panning.
[*] Scrolling in the research tree is now vertical instead of horizontal.
[*] Fixed the unstuck feature sometimes spawning the player outside the station/ship.
[*] Enemy ships no longer spawn in the immediate vicinity of the player on world generation.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player character despawning when disassembling a ship.
[*] Ship reactor auto fuel input is now toggleable.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Release 9
notes.content:
This release introduces the beginning of the new building and blueprint system, but integration with the survival gameplay is still in a very experimental state. Check out the designer, but expect some issues with progressing in survival.

[b]Rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ships and stations have been changed to being made up of a unified set of modules.
[*] Added a new designer mode, and ship/station blueprints that can be saved and loaded.
[*] Removed drones, ore is now collected using the tractor beam.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Research tree does not match the new building system.
[*] Some colliders are not aligned.
[*] Ship must be centered on the building grid for proper steering.
[*] Remove modules will remove their inventory contents without refund.
[*] Piloting HUD does not show reactor(s) fuel levels.
[*] Warp drive does not work.
[/list]
[b]Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked world generation. Now, asteroids generate continuously throughout the solar system, with a few higher density points-of-interest that can be viewed in the map.
[*] Improved the ship strafing controls. Now, holding sprint (SHIFT) while piloting lets you use WASD to strafe, making maneuvering around asteroids easier.
[*] Improved load game menu. Save entries are now sorted by most recent.
[*] Expanded the game world to include multiple star systems, viewable in the map.
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small enemy fighters are now slower and have less health.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with teleporting when walking on or off a station.
[*] Fixed the player walking too fast when moving diagonally.
[*] Fixed freezing when loading them map
[*] Fixed a bug with conveyor rotations.
[/list]

[*] Improved the ship strafing controls. Now, holding sprint (SHIFT) while piloting lets you use WASD to strafe, making maneuvering around asteroids easier.
[*] Improved load game menu. Save entries are now sorted by most recent.
[*] Expanded the game world to include multiple star systems, viewable in the map.

notes.title: Playtest Build 2
notes.content:
Note: Because of the world generation changes, save files from the previous build are not compatible with this one.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked world generation. Now, the solar system is generated in discrete sectors with unique resources.
[*] Added enemy fighters and shipyards. Destroy the enemy bases to make gathering resources safer. Monitor your health, and repair your ship from the ship's status window.
[*] Added a map with sector and solar system views. Use the solar system view to toggle the HUD markers for navigating to other sectors in the solar system.
[*] Added warp fuel, which can be unlocked using computation science. Use warp fuel to travel to the other sectors in the solar system.
[/list]
